map.四六级/考研/托福词库，随机测试，生词本功能: CET-4 / CET-6, postgraduate and TOEFL word lists, random quizzes, plus a personal word book
map.📖 查看「英语单词测试 使用指南」: 📖 View the "English Vocabulary Test User Guide"
map.从词库（四六级/考研/托福等）随机抽取单词进行拼写或选择测试，按正确率反馈；生词: Words are drawn at random from the word lists (CET-4 / CET-6, postgraduate, TOEFL and others) for spelling or multiple-choice questions, with feedback based on accuracy; new words can be saved into a word book (localStorage) for repeated review. Question selection and marking happen entirely in the browser, so the data never leaves it.
map.间隔重复（如按遗忘曲线）比一次性背诵更高效。: Spaced repetition (for example along the forgetting curve) is more efficient than cramming once.
map.词库为通用样例，备考以官方大纲词汇为准。: The word lists are general samples; when preparing for an exam follow the official syllabus vocabulary.
map.📚 深度解析：从四六级/考研/托福等词库随机抽词进行拼写或选择测试，按正确率反馈: 📚 In-depth: draws random words from CET-4 / CET-6, postgraduate and TOEFL lists for spelling or multiple-choice questions, gives accuracy feedback, and saves new words into a word book for cyclic review.
map.随机抽词：按词库层级抽题。: Random drawing: questions come from the chosen word-list level.
map.拼写/选择：多种题型。: Spelling / multiple choice: several question types.
map.生词本：错词存入复习。: Word book: missed words are stored for revision.
map.示例：抽词「abandon」，选择释义或拼写。: Example: draws "abandon" for a definition choice or a spelling question.
map.内置常见考试词表，可切换层级。: Built-in word lists for common exams, switchable by level.
map.答错词存入 localStorage 循环复习。: Missed words are stored in localStorage for repeated review.
map.考前单词快速记忆与自测。: Fast vocabulary memorization and self-testing before exams.
